power.rationale: Least roster turnover in the league; TE a minor gap. Full continuity. UPSIDE: Uwazurike a solid rotational riser. DOWNSIDE: most complete, healthiest roster in the league — lowest risk in the AFC.

Minor WR3 depth question on an otherwise elite roster. Zero coaching turnover, Garrett trade major boost. UPSIDE: Stewart has a real complementary role now that Garrett is aboard. DOWNSIDE: deep, talented, but an aging core led by a 37+-year-old Stafford.

Fewest roster issues in the AFC; minor RB2 concern. Full continuity. UPSIDE: Calen Bullock already excellent, limited room to climb further. DOWNSIDE: stable, healthy core — lowest risk in the division.

Etienne's departure leaves a low-importance RB committee. Full continuity. UPSIDE: Ruke Orhorhoro gets a fresh start on a thin DT chart. DOWNSIDE: Lawrence's health/consistency remains a swing factor.
Real Edge rusher hole unaddressed. Full staff continuity. Vrabel distraction offset by A.J. Brown trade. UPSIDE: Jared Wilson a real but modest breakout case. DOWNSIDE: no major star-injury flag.

WR depth beyond JSN, plus an aging Kupp, a real concern. OC change only. Champions' momentum. UPSIDE: AJ Barner is a real 'discount Kittle' breakout case. DOWNSIDE: aging defensive core post-title, but no major injury flags currently. UPDATE (Jul 2026): RB Zach Charbonnet's ACL recovery could cost him the start of the season -- a real, newly reported risk not previously priced in. Downside raised; rookie Jadarian Price picking up snaps is a modest offsetting positive already reflected in Upside.

Drafted Tyson 8th overall; Shough's emergence solved QB for free. Zero coaching turnover. UPSIDE: Riley/Sanker both real 'struck gold' mid-round finds. DOWNSIDE: Shough is still a one-year-sample rookie QB.

Traded A.J. Brown, lost starting safety — real subtractions. Zero coaching turnover. UPSIDE: Smith Jr./Hunt both real breakout candidates. DOWNSIDE: Smith's recurring triceps injury; core aging out of its title window.

Interior DL got 'zero improvement.' Zero coaching turnover, Williams breakout momentum. UPSIDE: Burden III tied A.J. Brown's rookie efficiency record. DOWNSIDE: young, ascending, healthy core — low risk.

TE hole unaddressed (low weight), but real defensive investment. Zero coaching turnover, reigning champs. UPSIDE: Scourton gets easier snaps next to a premium new Edge signing. DOWNSIDE: Young carries some lingering performance/confidence risk.

CB depth thin, but defense saw major additions. DC change only. Rare drama-free summer. UPSIDE: no standout star-level breakout beyond a re-breakout case. DOWNSIDE: Overshown still recovering from a severe multi-ligament knee injury.

Real WR2 hole after trading Pittman. Full continuity, Jones extension resolves QB uncertainty. UPSIDE: Josh Downs has real target-share upside. DOWNSIDE: Jones carries a real recent injury history. UPDATE (Jul 2026): WR Alec Pierce's ankle surgery (Jan PRP failed, March surgery) carries a 4-6 month recovery that could cost him the preseason and part of the regular season -- layers onto an already-thin WR2 situation. Downside raised modestly.

LB corps a real but moderate weakness. Full staff turnover, softened by internal promotion. UPSIDE: T.J. Sanders a rotational DT projection. DOWNSIDE: LB corps carrying an undisclosed injury into camp.
TE production weak but low-importance. Zero coaching turnover. QB competition unresolved. UPSIDE: James Pierre a solid rotational corner add. DOWNSIDE: QB uncertainty already priced into Stability.
Offensive guard remains the weak link. OC+DC change, HC retained. UPSIDE: Jamaree Caldwell projects for more pass-rush reps. DOWNSIDE: Herbert carries some recent injury history.

Center a weak link, but most other holes 'excellently' patched. Full staff overhaul, well-reviewed. UPSIDE: Darius Alexander has a real role opportunity. DOWNSIDE: D-line/scheme rebuild risk already priced into Scheme score.

Parsons' health leaves Edge thin — a real hole at a premium position. Zero coaching turnover. UPSIDE: Anthony Belton profiles as a real starting-caliber guard. DOWNSIDE: Parsons' own injury/return timeline is a major unresolved swing factor. UPDATE (Jul 2026): Parsons' ACL+meniscus recovery is now reported as likely to sideline him for much of the regular season (not cleared for practice until Sept at earliest, targeting a postseason return) -- worse than an uncertain-timeline framing. Stability and Downside both raised.

No reliable free safety after Hufanga-era departures. DC change (Raheem Morris hired). UPSIDE: Upton Stout a solid, unspectacular slot-corner riser. DOWNSIDE: Aiyuk saga unresolved; recent history of major injury attrition.
Historically bad vs. TEs, bottom-8 defense 3 years running. Full continuity. UPSIDE: Erick All Jr. could lead TE room if healthy. DOWNSIDE: All's own ACL history plus Burrow's recent injury history.

TE room remains least productive, unaddressed. Fired OC, hired Robinson — real scheme risk. UPSIDE: McMillan is the top candidate for outside-WR snaps. DOWNSIDE: McMillan's own injury history (hamstring, neck) plus Mayfield contract situation.
Interior OL a real flaw but offseason 'extremely productive.' Full continuity into Year 2. UPSIDE: T'Vondre Sweat has real breakout DT upside. DOWNSIDE: full rebuild, but no major star injury.

WR depth issue broader than believed; Kelce aging. OC change, familiar system. UPSIDE: Nohl Williams has a real path to a starting job. DOWNSIDE: aging core around Mahomes/Kelce (36) plus Rice's suspension risk. UPDATE (Jul 2026): Mahomes tore ACL+LCL in Week 15 2025; Week 1 2026 availability genuinely uncertain despite ahead-of-schedule rehab reports. This is materially worse than 'aging core' framing -- Downside and Stability both raised.

Secondary riddled with red flags: an arrest, an Achilles tear, a knee issue. OC change only. UPSIDE: Roger McCreary a real bounce-back opportunity. DOWNSIDE: secondary already hit hard (also priced into Need-Fill/Stability). UPDATE (Jul 2026): Kerby Joseph's status is now 'team does not know when or if he will return' per HC Dan Campbell -- more severe than a recovery-timeline question. Downside and Stability both raised.

Right guard unsettled, protecting a 42-year-old Rodgers. Full staff overhaul. UPSIDE: Zach Frazier profiles as a top center. DOWNSIDE: Rodgers is 42 — the single largest age/health swing factor in the league.

Lost All-Pro C Linderbaum; replacements are career backups. Full HC/OC/DC overhaul. UPSIDE: Keyon Martin a deep-cut slot corner projection. DOWNSIDE: Lamar Jackson has a real recent injury-availability history.

Both starting interior DL starters departed, only depth pieces added. New HC+OC, DC retained. UPSIDE: Dorlus' 'lightbulb' breakout is real per scouts. DOWNSIDE: Penix's ACL recovery unresolved AND Pearce Jr. faces felony charges with 2026 availability in doubt.

WR2 opposite McLaurin never addressed. OC+DC change, HC retained. UPSIDE: McLaurin has an explicit real career-year case in a new offense. DOWNSIDE: Daniels' own health/durability is the swing factor for the whole offense.

Secondary still unaddressed. HC+DC change. Cam Ward's rookie emergence real momentum. UPSIDE: Ward + Helm both made the league's All-Breakout Team — strongest upside case in the division. DOWNSIDE: Ward still unproven, division-worst roster underneath.
Weakest WR core 'we've ever seen.' Full rebuild: new HC+OC+DC. UPSIDE: Patrick Paul an ascending young LT. DOWNSIDE: full teardown, thin depth if anyone goes down.

No reliable starting QB through the whole season — the worst need-fill situation in the league. HC+OC change. UPSIDE: Walter Nolen III flashed Pro-Bowl-caliber play in limited snaps. DOWNSIDE: Nolen's own major injury history makes him a genuine boom-or-bust factor.
QB has been the defining issue for decades, still unresolved. Full staff overhaul. UPSIDE: Tyson Campbell a proven vet in a bigger role. DOWNSIDE: still rebuilding around an unresolved QB room.
No legitimate WR1/X receiver. Full staff overhaul. UPSIDE: Ashton Jeanty a real regression-to-mean buy-low case. DOWNSIDE: full rebuild, unproven rookie QB succession plan.
